description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and memory usage in GB for various models, including VideoLLaMB, VideoLLaMB-R, LLaVA-NeXT, and VideoLLAVA. The x-axis represents the number of frames, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, marked at intervals of 200. The y-axis represents memory usage in GB, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, marked at intervals of 50. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different model: VideoLLaMB (pink, dashed line with circle markers), VideoLLaMB-R (brown, dashed line with circle markers), LLaVA-NeXT (blue, solid line with circle markers), and VideoLLAVA (purple, dashed line with circle markers). VideoLLaMB and VideoLLaMB-R overlap throughout the plot, starting at around 20 GB and increasing to approximately 30 GB at 1000 frames. LLaVA-NeXT starts at around 20 GB and rises to about 130 GB at 1000 frames. VideoLLAVA begins at around 30 GB and sharply increases to over 400 GB at 300 frames.
